analysis_role: Post-result robustness quantification of the already observed unequal relative-lineage-depth pattern. This is not an independent preregistered hypothesis test.
primary_estimand: For the same UFBoot topology, compare the lower bound of mean relative lineage depth across all globally minimum-cost histories. Smaller D means that a trait permits a deeper mean placement. Bootstrap trees are sensitivity realizations, not independent biological replicates.

pairwise_questions.reason: The frozen ensemble summaries place phyllary deeper and stickiness shallow; quantify topology-wise robustness.
The frozen ensemble summaries place orientation deeper and stickiness shallow; quantify topology-wise robustness.
Quantify whether the apparent phyllary-versus-orientation ordering is itself stable or mixed.

secondary_estimands: paired difference in lower depth bound
fraction of topologies with the prespecified lower-bound direction
fraction of topologies with the complete lower-bound ordering phyllary < orientation < stickiness

direction_labels.robust: prespecified lower-bound direction in >=0.95 of UFBoot topologies
direction_labels.stable: prespecified lower-bound direction in >=0.80 and <0.95 of UFBoot topologies
direction_labels.mixed: prespecified lower-bound direction in <0.80 of UFBoot topologies

interpretation_boundary: A lower depth bound means that at least one globally minimum-cost history can place the mean change burden deeper; it is not an estimated event age.
Pairwise UFBoot fractions quantify topology sensitivity and must not be reported as probabilities, confidence levels, or independent replicate frequencies.
This analysis cannot establish independent origins, genetic modularity, adaptation, selection, or a causal mechanism.
Because this follow-up was motivated by the frozen ensemble summaries, it strengthens description of robustness but is not an independent confirmation of the unequal-depth hypothesis.
